title.en: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay Digon, Municipality of Margosatubig, Province of Zamboanga Del Sur to Be Known as Digon National

text.en: There is hereby established, under the supervision of the Department of Education, a national high school in Barangay Digon, Municipality of Margosatubig, Province of Zamboanga del Sur to be known as Digon National High School.

The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department’s program the operationalization of the Digon National High School, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
The Secretary of Education shall formulate the rules and regulations implementing the provisions of this Act within one hundred twenty (120) days after its effectivity.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
